title: Playing the Fool: Jailbreaking LLMs and Multimodal LLMs with Out-of-Distribution Strategy
reasoning: The paper investigates and benchmarks the bypass of safety and ethical guardrails in LLMs. It specifically evaluates model responses using a 'Harmfulness Score' (HF) across categories with clear ethical implications, such as 'Social Violence', 'Self-harm', and 'Drugs', thereby measuring the failure of the model's ethical and moral alignment.
